metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-nu[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Command chips: one-gesture bob runs from Obsidian notes[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Typing `run: bob …` in an inline code span, or a `bob-run` fence, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]gives a quiet ▶ chip. One click or ⌘↵ runs it through Bob Command [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Mode the way the sheet's Ctrl+Enter would. A chip holds one command[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]or a whole `&&` sequence, and its run state shows in place. The [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]copy-chip plugin becomes `bob-chips` and owns both kinds, and the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]GTD rows that hold bob commands become command chips.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]8[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202611/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]command_chips.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202611/command_chips.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]bob-cli-nu[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-nu/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Rename bob-copy-chips to bob-chips with no behavior change[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]rename[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]rename: move the copy-chip plugin to the id bob-chips. The phase [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]includes a dual-listed transition and a double-load guard. It updates [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]every touchpoint: the navigation C-row lookup, docs, chezmoi allowlist, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]vault enablement, the vimrc obcommand ids, and a bob-cli docs redirect. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Copy-chip behavior and api.copyChips v2 stay byte-stable.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Command Mode chip engine (resolve, runText, openText, [/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]provenance)[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]engine[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]engine: add feature-detected api.commandMode members. resolve(text) [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]parses a chip payload into catalog-legal steps. runText runs it with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sheet Ctrl+Enter semantics plus the confirm floor, and openText is the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]guarded path. Also add activeRun and onCatalogChanged, plus [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]trigger/source provenance on run records. One activation planner is [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]shared with the sheet so they can never drift.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]run:/bob-run grammar, command-chip cursor rule, and vectors[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]grammar[dim] · [dim][/dim]after rename[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]grammar: build the pure run: and bob-run grammar on the shared scanner, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with a serializer, link spans, and the command-chip chipAt rule (under [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]cursor, link, line, task). Publish the pure members of api.commandChips [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]v1, pinned by JSON vectors and a round-trip test.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Inline command chips in Live Preview and Reading view[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]inline[dim] · [dim][/dim]after grammar, engine[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]inline: render run: spans as ▶ pills in Live Preview and Reading view. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Click runs through runText and Shift+Click opens Command Mode. Live [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]state comes from a store keyed by signature. Unavailable and copy-only [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]faces cover no-run folders, mobile, and a missing Command Mode. Includes[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]visual previews, perf, and stub-bob e2e.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The bob-run sequence card[/bold #D7AFFF]                                     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]fence[dim] · [dim][/dim]after inline[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]fence: render bob-run fences as titled sequence cards. Each card has [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]numbered monospace steps, a Run button, per-step live marks, unavailable[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and copy-only variants, and an armed state.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]⌘↵ runs the command chip at the cursor, with an armed chip and[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]keycap hint[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]keymap[dim] · [dim][/dim]after inline[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]keymap: compose a command-chip step into the existing Meta+Enter [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dispatcher in bob-navigation-hotkeys, add targetAt/runAtCursor and a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]palette command, and paint the armed chip and a muted ⌘↵ Run keycap from[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the live binding. The Gmail and Highlights hints yield, and every old ⌘↵[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]target is regression-tested.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Mod+Shift+Y makes and edits command chips[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]author[dim] · [dim][/dim]after fence[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]author: extend the make-or-edit card with a Copy | Run kind row. Run [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]drafts get live per-step validation from resolve, an Add-bob fix, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]inline-or-fence serialization. Conversion defaults are predictable, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Alt+Click edits a command chip.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]GTD rows, guide, glossary, and coordination[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]adopt[dim] · [dim][/dim]after keymap, author[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]adopt: convert the open gtd_daily.md rows that hold bob commands (the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Bank row only once the Mac's bob has -D), add the vimrc comment and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bob-cli guide section, apply the accepted memory decisions, and leave [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]coordination notes on bob-cli-nc and bob-cli-nn.[/#D7D7AF]
